claim: In the host network mode the task bypasses Docker's virtual network by mapping container ports directly to the ENI of the EC2 instance, dynamic port mappings can't be used, and you can't run multiple tasks of the same task definition on a single instance.
question: What are the limits of the ECS host network mode?

values.display: mapping container ports directly to the ENI of the Amazon EC2 instance
you can’t run multiple tasks of the same task definition on a single Amazon EC2 instance

qualifiers.scope: Amazon ECS tasks on Amazon EC2 Linux
qualifiers.condition: a container must specify a specific hostPort number
